description: Golden vectors for lib/fingerprint.js (IDM fingerprinting). The Rust agent must reproduce these byte-for-byte. Hashes are SIGNED 64-bit decimals (PostgreSQL BIGINT form). Do not regenerate casually: changing them is a breaking protocol change.

vectors.name: long-document-500-words
vectors.input: Operational summary for the quarterly review of the coastal monitoring programme. During the reporting period the field teams completed one hundred and twelve scheduled patrols along the designated shoreline sectors, recording tidal conditions, vessel movements, and any anomalies observed near the restricted anchorage. Sensor uptime across the buoy network averaged ninety seven percent, with the two outages traced to battery degradation in units deployed before the last refresh cycle. Replacement cells were fitted within forty eight hours of each fault being raised, and the maintenance log was updated to reflect the revised service interval. The data ingestion pipeline processed roughly four million telemetry frames without loss, although a schema mismatch in the wind vector field caused a brief backlog on the second week of the quarter. Engineering resolved the mismatch by versioning the frame parser and replaying the buffered stream, and no downstream reports were affected. Training activity focused on the new incident classification handbook, with all duty analysts completing the certification module before the cutover date. Feedback from the cohort highlighted the worked examples on ambiguous contact reports as the most valuable section of the material. Liaison meetings with the harbour authority were held twice, covering the proposed extension of the exclusion zone and the schedule for dredging operations near the southern breakwater. Minutes from both meetings were circulated to the distribution list and archived under the standard retention policy. Budget execution stands at seventy one percent of the annual allocation, tracking slightly under the forecast because the planned radar upgrade slipped into the next quarter. Procurement has confirmed that the revised delivery window does not jeopardise the installation slot booked with the contractor. Weather over the period was dominated by two prolonged low pressure systems, which reduced small craft traffic and correspondingly lowered the number of routine identification queries. No safety incidents involving programme personnel were recorded, and the near miss register received a single entry concerning a slippery gangway that has since been resurfaced. Looking ahead, the priorities for the coming quarter are the radar installation, the migration of the archive to the new storage cluster, and the joint exercise with the neighbouring district. Preparatory work for the exercise begins with a tabletop session in the first week, followed by a communications check involving every field station. The programme office will publish the consolidated risk register alongside the next monthly bulletin. All queries regarding this summary should be directed to the duty coordination cell through the usual reporting channel. An annex to this document lists the serial numbers of every sensor unit currently deployed, together with its firmware revision, battery installation date, and the identifier of the technician responsible for its most recent inspection. A second annex reconciles the patrol schedule against the actual departure and return times logged at each station, noting the three occasions on which weather forced an early recall. Readers should note that figures quoted in this summary are provisional until the finance team completes its end of quarter reconciliation, at which point a corrected edition will be issued if any material difference is found. The distribution of this report is restricted to named recipients, and any request for onward sharing must be approved by the programme security officer before a copy leaves the controlled list.
